title: Poncho G - Diabla (Feat. Godxeb and Qvinn)
htmlContent:
Poncho G shares a new track called "Diabla" Featuring Godxeb and Qvinn. The production of this song is skilled and the moment is extraordinary. The first few seconds of this record will be enough to have you hooked for a long time.

Poncho G, Godxeb and Qvinn lyrics are original and well written. Poncho G is a masterful artist and we are super excited to see where his career will go over the coming months!
